profile_name: Smaller or less active local economy
when_to_use: Mostly rural, residential, remote, conflict-affected, or with limited formal jobs, firms, markets, tourism, services, or taxable commercial activity.
calibration_note: Rounded from local-admin GDP/pop calibration, with conservative cap for the hub category.

when_to_use: Use when the area does not clearly stand out as richer or poorer than the country average. This is the safest default.
calibration_note: Rounded from local-admin GDP/pop calibration, with conservative cap for the hub category.

when_to_use: Use for a county/municipal hub, regional market town, administrative centre, university/health centre, logistics node, or diversified secondary city.
calibration_note: Rounded from local-admin GDP/pop calibration, with conservative cap for the hub category.

profile_name: Large city with strong local economy
when_to_use: Use for a large urban jurisdiction with many firms, formal jobs, services, real estate, industry, tourism, or major markets, but not the country’s dominant hub.
calibration_note: Rounded from local-admin GDP/pop calibration, with conservative cap for the hub category.

profile_name: Main national hub, capital, or port
when_to_use: Use only when the jurisdiction concentrates a very large share of national firms, jobs, trade, finance, government, logistics, port activity, tourism, or strategic assets.
calibration_note: Rounded from local-admin GDP/pop calibration, with conservative cap for the hub category.
